x-nestor.title: Personality
x-nestor.help: Who the assistant is and how it speaks.

x-nestor.title: Language
x-nestor.help: E.g. en-US. Language of fixed phrases and, by default, of the admin.

x-nestor.title: Reply language
x-nestor.help: Its name in the prompt, e.g. English.

x-nestor.title: Accounts
x-nestor.help: How channels recognise this person, e.g. telegram:123456789.

x-nestor.title: May send a message to
x-nestor.help: Through the assistant, to others: person identifiers, or * for everyone. Anyone may write to themselves.

agent.description:
Which model of `models` answers in each medium. One left out takes the other's; with a single
model, neither needs saying. `transcription` hears the voice messages people send and `speech` records the
answers to them; each defaults to the only model of its type, and without one, voice messages go unheard and
answers stay written.

x-nestor.title: Spoken model
x-nestor.help: For spoken replies. The written model by default.

x-nestor.title: Written model
x-nestor.help: For written replies. The spoken model by default.

x-nestor.title: Titles model
x-nestor.help: Titles each conversation from its first exchange, as lists show it. A small model is enough; the written model by default.

x-nestor.title: Voice message transcription
x-nestor.help: Hears the voice messages people send. By default, the only transcription model.

x-nestor.title: Voice of voice messages
x-nestor.help: Answers a voice message with one. By default, the only speech model.

x-nestor.title: Tool wait when speaking (s)
x-nestor.help: Past this, the tool keeps running in the background and its result comes back in the conversation.

x-nestor.title: Tool wait when writing (s)
x-nestor.help: Past this, the tool keeps running in the background and its result comes back in the conversation.

x-nestor.title: Tool result size (characters)
x-nestor.help: A longer result is stored aside: the model sees its start and end, and reads the rest when it needs it.

agent.title: AgentConfig

watches.description: The model that sorts incoming items for the watches: the agent's written one by default.

x-nestor.title: Sorting model
x-nestor.help: Picks the watches each incoming item concerns. The written model by default.

watches.title: WatchesConfig

memory.description:
Which memories each turn's instructions carry (`memory-recall` bench): the latest up to `recent`, cached
with the household, then those the person's last messages find among the others.

x-nestor.title: Memory selection
x-nestor.help: both: the latest, then those the conversation brings up; recent: the latest only; search: those the conversation brings up only.

x-nestor.title: Recent conversations per turn
x-nestor.help: Those of whoever speaks, summarized.

x-nestor.title: Summarizing model
x-nestor.help: Summarizes each finished conversation. The written model by default.

x-nestor.title: Embedding model
x-nestor.help: Searches memories by meaning. Without one, by keywords only.

x-nestor.title: Embedding timeout (seconds)
x-nestor.help: Past it, the search uses keywords only.

memory.title: MemoryConfig

x-nestor.title: Quiet hours
x-nestor.help: E.g. 22:30-07:30. Nothing aloud, unless urgent.

x-nestor.title: Main room
x-nestor.help: Where to speak when the home only knows someone is in.

admin.description:
The admin web interface; without this section, Nestor serves none. Who may sign in is not
configured here: accounts live in the database (`nestor init`, `nestor accounts create-owner`).

x-nestor.title: Public URL
x-nestor.help: The admin's URL, e.g. https://nestor.example.org.

admin.title: AdminConfig

updates.description:
Whether Nestor reads its release feed to tell the admin about newer releases. It installs one only
when a person asks in the admin, and only where it runs from its own Python environment.

x-nestor.title: Check for new releases
x-nestor.help: Once a day, without installing anything.
